integrity: The known exact Floquet formula is cited as prior background; the asserted contribution is singular optimization, unique maximizer and sharp coefficient. Numerical checks supplement an analytical proof; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The principal linear Floquet exponent is optimized only for constant symmetric migration and fast exactly alternating seasons. The equality case in the rescaled mortality threshold is not decided. No stochastic or nonlinear persistence inference is claimed.
title: Optimal migration grows inversely with the season length in a two-habitat sink model
